messages:
zoe: Heads-up - support got a ticket where service-account keys routed to the wrong quota bucket during a region failover. Threading a few quick ideas.

ashish: Any trace? region headers?

zoe: short trace: `svc-router: route_hint=us-west2 -> chosen=us-east1 (fallback) ; auth.resolve(sa_key) delayed 95ms -> project found` so the runtime used the fallback route and the request hit org quota in us-east1.

mike: Two issues: routing decision vs attribution race, and telemetry doesn't show 'route_reason' in request inspector which makes debugging painful.

dina: UX: add an inline compact "route_explain" line in inspector showing "chosen / reason / lookup_ms" so support can quickly see why we fell back.

ashish: Agree on telemetry. Proposal: add tags: `auth.route_reason: hit|miss|timeout|fallback`, `auth.lookup_ms`, `route.chosen_region`. Also add a sampled debug trace when `route_explain=true` flag present.

zoe: Operational change idea: for region failover, prefer keeping cookie-affinity to project when available. If lookup returns later, do not re-route the live request, but mark attribution as re-evaluated. That avoids double-routing but lets billing reassign if within window.

mike: We also need a new metric `auth.route_mismatch_rate` (count when serving_region != resolved_region) and alert if > 0.5% over 5m for any org.

dina: For the console: small gray pill "served_in: us-east1 (fallback)" and if reattributed show a subtle green check and text "final: proj-foo in us-west2". Also link to route_explain expanded view.

azish: typo — ashish: I'll implement the metrics and sampled debug traces. Plan: add `route_explain` boolean on request context that triggers 1/1000 sampling by default, 1/10 for support-flagged API keys.

ashish: Implementation notes: keep sampling cheap — only capture key IDs, chosen route, resolved identity, lookup timing, and router decision. Store as trace tag, not full span, to avoid storage blow-up.

infra-bot: feature flag `route-explain-sampled` created -> staging 2024-10-07T09:00Z.

zoe: Rollout plan: enable in staging, run synthetic cross-region failover test, validate `auth.route_mismatch_rate` and inspector UI. If green, 2% prod canary then ramp.

mike: Quick follow-ups: add `billing.rewrite_attempts` metric and cap reattributes per request to 1. Also confirm billing export window alignment with attribution TTL.

dina: I'll prototype the inspector card tonight and post screenshots.

ashish: Action items:
- ashish: metrics + sampled trace flag + cap reattributes=1
- zoe: create synthetic failover harness
- dina: inspector mock + copy
- mike: coordinate billing export alignment

zoe: Thanks all — will follow up with staging results here. :thumbsup:
